title: Desmoid fibromatosis 1
extract_protocol_ch1: RNA was extracted using the TRIzol reagent (Invitrogen) and purified with Qiagen´s RNeasy kit according to the manufacturers´ instructions.
label_protocol_ch1: cDNA was labelled with TdT using the WT Terminal Labeling kit (Affymetrix).
hyb_protocol: Biotinylated cDNA was hybridized to GeneChip Gene 1_0 st arrays. Arrays were washed and stained on an Affymetrix Fluidics Station 450.
scan_protocol: Scanning was carried out with the GeneChip Scanner 3000 (Affymetrix).
data_processing: Image analysis was perfomed using the GeneChip Operating Software (GCOS, Affymetrix). Background correction, normalization and probe summarization was done with the robust multichip average (RMA) algorithm implemented in the Expression Console software (Affymetrix).
